parameters.name: FaceBase64
parameters.description:
Enter the Base64 encoded string of the face image.
> Either FaceUrl or FaceBase64 must be provided.

parameters.name: FaceInputType
parameters.description: Input **IMAGE** to indicate an image type.

parameters.name: FaceUrl
parameters.description:
Enter the URL of the face image.
> Either FaceUrl or FaceBase64 must be provided.

parameters.name: OuterOrderNo
parameters.description: A unique identifier for the merchant's request, consisting of a 32-character alphanumeric combination. The first few characters can be a custom abbreviation defined by the merchant, the middle part may include a timestamp, and the latter part can use a random or incrementing sequence.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth deepfake-detect --outer-order-no e0c34a77f5ac40a5aa5e6ed20c000000 --face-input-type IMAGE --face-url https://cn-shanghai-aliyun-cloudauth-xxxxxx.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/verify/xxxxx/xxxxx.jpeg --face-base64 /9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAASxxxxxxx --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth DeepfakeDetect --region cn-hangzhou --FaceBase64 '/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAASxxxxxxx' --FaceInputType IMAGE --OuterOrderNo e0c34a77f5ac40a5aa5e6ed20c000000 --FaceUrl 'https://cn-shanghai-aliyun-cloudauth-xxxxxx.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/verify/xxxxx/xxxxx.jpeg'
